task_title: First spec attempt fails cryptically: docs gap
task_criteria: docs/troubleshooting.md contains the '# speclang-header lines:N must exactly equal header length' rule; README or docs document OPENAI_API_KEY / cascade LLM provider setup

items.criterion: docs/troubleshooting.md contains the '# speclang-header lines:N must exactly equal header length' rule; README or docs document OPENAI_API_KEY / cascade LLM provider setup
items.detail: docs/troubleshooting.md is a symlink to specs/roadmap.spec.dir/poc.spec.dir/troubleshooting.spec.md (`diff` reports IDENTICAL), so the change to the spec twin lands in the doc. Rule present at docs/troubleshooting.md:375-376: "**The rule:** `N` = 1 (the `# speclang-header` line) + the number of YAML lines + 1 (the closing `---` line)", inside the new `## First-Spec Failures` section (docs/troubleshooting.md:337), with the trap table at :405-411. I verified the documented behaviour empirically against dist/src/parser/header.js on the doc's own 6-line header: N=6 -> OK, N=7 -> OK (trailing `---` stripped), N=8 and N=9 -> "Failed to parse header YAML: Source contains multiple documents", N=5 -> `tags` dropped, N=4 -> `layer`+`tags` dropped — exactly what the table claims; the omitted-count escape hatch parses and yields the warning at specs/validation.spec.dir/src/rules/header.ts:66-74. LLM provider setup is documented in both places: docs/troubleshooting.md:483-520 (key table :499-502, SPECLANG_PROVIDER/SPECLANG_MODEL/SPECLANG_BASE_URL :504, `export OPENAI_API_KEY` :511, missing-key error text matching specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/agent.ts:217) and README.md:405-426. Every documented env var, default model and the `gemini` alias match the code (specs/cascade.spec.dir/src/agent.ts:47-58,76-83,105-115; provider-adapter.ts:20-32). `./bin/speclang check specs/roadmap.spec.dir/poc.spec.dir/troubleshooting.spec.md` -> "✓ Passed", "Errors: 0, Warnings: 0". Full suite `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests`: "Test Files 2 failed | 104 passed", "Tests 2 failed | 1902 passed | 58 skipped" — the two failures are tests/cascade-depth.test.ts:212 (timer flake) and tests/db.test.ts:36 ("SqliteError: disk I/O error"), both unrelated to this docs-only change. [resolution 0.31; docs/troubleshooting.md]
